patch_description: Replace repeated neighborhood descent with an estimation-of-distribution search. It learns which links occur in strong evaluated networks, combines that signal with a mild demand-based prior and LP bottleneck feedback, then samples new valid networks directly as unions of two disjoint derangements. A small share of candidates are multi-switch mutations of elite networks to preserve useful structure while still exploring beyond their immediate neighborhoods. This gives the LP budget a broader set of topologies to evaluate than repeatedly searching around a small set of parents.
